business_problem: SAIC Volkswagen needed to support multiple service and marketing departments, headquarters, regions, and dealers from one customer-direct-contact center while expanding dual-brand operations, multichannel access, and customer-insight capture without disrupting the existing platform.
solution_summary: SAIC Volkswagen used Baidu AI Cloud to upgrade its CDCC customer-direct-contact-center platform into a broader intelligent service hub. Rather than replacing the existing platform, the project optimized key workflows while preserving current operations and architectural flexibility. Baidu extended customer-service coverage and used customer-insight capabilities to pull in more channel data and capture additional voice-of-customer signals. The upgraded center supports both SAIC Volkswagen and Skoda service and marketing requirements across headquarters, regional teams, and dealers, while also adapting to instant-messaging and social-channel evolution. In effect, the platform becomes a multichannel contact-center layer where customer interactions, knowledge updates, and service processes are managed together.
products_used: Baidu AI Cloud Intelligent Customer Service

solution_components.name: Baidu AI Cloud Intelligent Customer Service
solution_components.role: Provides the AI service capabilities used to upgrade SAIC Volkswagen's contact-center workflows.

solution_components.name: CDCC Customer Direct Contact Center
solution_components.role: Acts as the operational platform that was expanded and optimized for dual-brand customer contact and service.

solution_components.name: ASR
solution_components.role: Supports speech recognition inside the upgraded service and contact-center workflows.

data_flow: Customer interactions from contact-center, messaging, and social channels flow through the upgraded CDCC platform. AI capabilities analyze the conversations, add customer-insight data, and feed updated knowledge and service workflows back to headquarters, regional teams, and dealer operations.
business_outcome: SAIC Volkswagen improved knowledge creation and search, expanded channel coverage, and gave its dual-brand customer-service operation a more flexible backbone for service and marketing workflows.
architecture_clues: The project keeps the existing CDCC platform running while optimizing core workflows
The upgraded center is designed to support both Volkswagen and Skoda customer-service and marketing operations
Customer-insight expansion brings more channel data and voice-of-customer signals into the operating model
evidence_quotes: The project supports many service departments across headquarters, regions, and dealers while meeting dual-brand customer-service and marketing expansion needs for SAIC Volkswagen and Skoda (original: 覆盖总部、区域及经销商…需要满足上汽大众和斯柯达双品牌客户服务、营销业务的扩展与效率要求).

The solution continues to expand and optimize the existing CDCC customer-direct-contact-center platform without affecting current business operation or architectural flexibility (original: 基于客户现有的CDCC客户直联中心平台继续拓展优化，不影响当前业务运行和架构灵活性基础上进一步升级优化系统的关键业务流程).
The upgrade also extends customer-insight capabilities so more channel data can be extracted and more customer voice captured (original: 同时利用客户洞察扩展渠道数据，提取更多客户之声).

The case reports 30% knowledge addition efficiency, 70% knowledge search rate, 10% knowledge-business coverage, and 90% ASR recognition accuracy (original: 知识新增效率 30%；知识搜索率 70%；知识-业务覆盖率 10%；ASR识别率达到90%).
